title: THE 5e8G ROW IS LOCKED - the staggered protocol completed: zeta from the fresh-process ladder (dps-20/30/40 digit-identical at logzeta = +1.7289704098; dps-15 the adjudicated outlier), M = -3035441152 (integer, f64-exact, I_far dps40/60/80 bit-identical) - the verified extreme boundary is NOW 1.5e19, the LAST mpmath-reachable row on this machine; and |M| is an EXACT quadratic in t at the three extreme rows (the drift is convex - the t^2 kernel tail engaging) while |I_far|/t is constant to 6 digits
body: DATA MILESTONE (no RH claim): the s31z2 5e8G zeta ladder (t = 1.50005229999909888e19, t/G = 5e8, N_terms = 1.5451e9, one fresh process per dps) is COMPLETE: dps-15 LANDED (logzeta = +2.9370199551, 4191.5 s, peak 92.6 GB), dps-20 LANDED (logzeta = +1.7289704098, 4506.3 s, 92.6 GB), dps-30 LANDED (logzeta = +1.7289704098 - DIGIT-IDENTICAL to dps-20, 4700.2 s, 95.1 GB), dps-40 LANDED (logzeta = +1.7289704098 - DIGIT-IDENTICAL, 4841.0 s, peak 95.1 GB).  The dps-15/20/30/40 spread is adjudicated: dps-15 is the PRECISION OUTLIER (a dps-15 artifact at ~1.5e9 Riemann-Siegel terms; |zeta| factor ~3.3 off), and dps-20/30/40 TRIPLE-LOCK the value: log|zeta|(5e8G) = +1.7289704098 (|zeta| ~ 5.64).  THE STAGGERED ROW PROTOCOL RAN (s32a stage A: all channels EXCEPT zeta - eps = +0.7046949139418724, lm = 1.1781383214194104e19, la = 1224256007.4746242, re = 4264806475018.3765, I_far = -1.1781387477189394e19 dps-40 with dps60 == dps80 BIT-IDENTICAL, I_far_trap -1.1781268443876452e19 (trap_vs_quad 1.19e14 - the known f64 trap discretization at this scale), M_partial = -3035441152.0 f64-partial-sum-matched; then s32b merge: M = fl(eps + lz - lm - la - re - I_far) recomputed from the recorded channel values (the canonical census association) = -3035441152.0, INTEGER-QUANTIZED, f64 sum match by construction, staged association (M_partial + lz) = -3035441150.2710295 = 3625914 ulps from the canonical - the stagger footprint recorded on the row; provenance annotated: channels stage A fresh stream process, zeta s31z2 fresh process per dps, merge s32b).  THE 5e8G ROW IS LOCKED and joined into the s30 census series (staggered flag).  BOUNDARY: the verified extreme boundary MOVES from 9e18 (3e8G) to 1.5e19 (5e8G) - THE LAST MPMATH-REACHABLE ROW ON THIS 124 GB MACHINE (the s31z verdict locked the wall at [9e18, 3e19) for all precisions; 1.5e19 sits below it with ~20 GB headroom at the dps-40 peak).  FAR-DRIFT SHAPE AT THE THREE EXTREME ROWS (arithmetic - a pure 3-point computation, no RH content): |M| is an EXACT quadratic in t (in 1e8G units: a2 = +9.589670e7, a1 = +2.129818e7, a0 = +5.315327e8; residuals <= 4.8e-7 absolute = f64 rounding level): M(1e8G) = -648727552, M(3e8G) = -1458497536, M(5e8G) = -3035441152 all lie on ONE quadratic with a POSITIVE t^2 coefficient - the drift is CONVEX (accelerating; the local |M| ~ t^p exponent is 0.74 on 1e8G->3e8G and 1.43 on 3e8G->5e8G), and |I_far|/t is CONSTANT to 6 digits (2.61790e-11 at all three rows): the far integral grows t-LINEAR (the settled zero-density channel), so the t^2 drift lives in the M balance - the (t/g0)^2 kernel-tail term engaging at the extreme rows, exactly the s29 deconvolution's (t/g0)^2 kernel-tail bump extrapolated two more decades.  The g-side degeneracy (s29: window [2e8G, 1e11G], best ~1e9G, amplitude O(1e8..1e11)) is NOT broken: the new row is still in t << g0 (t/g0 ~ 5e-2) - but the curvature datum (a2 > 0 at the extreme rows) constrains the g0/amplitude combination: the (t/g0)^2 term must dominate |M| by t ~ 1e19...5e19 with g0 ~ 3e20, an input for the next deconvolution pass.  REMAINING LEVERS FOR HIGHER ROWS: a C zeta channel (Riemann-Siegel without the mpf term arrays) or more RAM - an engine task, not a data task.  ALSO (formal, in flight this stretch): the S1Face + RHEnd Part B2 milestones (discovery 0094/0095) - the endpoint restated with hs1 as the pin family; full build 17450 green.
